resources.string: Limit video when the phone is hot
Caps bitrate and frame rate from the phone\'s temperature, on top of the adaptive control.
Keep a picture every 0.1 s on a still screen
Helps docks that cut the video when nothing moves. Not used in Battery saver.
Lower quality only when the link is saturated
Counts a dropped link apart from a slow one, so a lost Wi-Fi no longer lowers the picture quality.
Rolling refresh instead of big periodic keyframes, if the phone\'s encoder supports it.
